meta.title: Right after an assignment, a new selection assigns exactly the ticked rows

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions screen in the buyer portal.

args.goal: without reloading after an existing assignment, tick exactly 2 items from PR 1005 and exactly 1 item from PR 1004, assign the selected items together, and stop when the screen proves that only those three ticked rows received the new assignee

steps.note: Perform and verify the row selection and assignment behavior that no catalog domain step exposes.
Confirm the final assignment screen has no visible errors, crashes, or malformed data.
